pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which tree is also called the peepal? (1 mark)
   A. Bodhi tree
   B. Ber tree
   C. Sal tree
   D. Tulsi

2. Where do Hindu families often grow Tulsi? (1 mark)
   A. Under the roof
   B. Only in a river
   C. In the kitchen fire
   D. In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard

3. Which time of day is best for watering plants? (1 mark)
   A. Midnight
   B. Any time in the hottest sun
   C. Noon
   D. Early morning or evening

4. Tulsi leaves are offered to which gods? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Shiva only
   B. Lord Mahavir
   C. Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna
   D. Guru Nanak

5. How did Prahlad react when his father was angry? (1 mark)
   A. He ran away forever
   B. He stayed calm and kept his faith
   C. He became cruel
   D. He gave up praying

6. What is a Tirthankar in Jainism? (1 mark)
   A. A temple
   B. A festival
   C. A teacher who shows the path across the river of life
   D. A king

7. How can you learn more about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to a resource person or visit a library
   B. Copy them from memory only
   C. Keep them in a bag
   D. Ignore them

8. What did Bharat place on the throne? (1 mark)
   A. Ram's sandals (paduka)
   B. A lamp
   C. A book
   D. A crown

9. Which action follows a Sikh teaching? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   B. Keeping it all
   C. Hiding your lunch
   D. Teasing the child

10. What does Ik Onkar stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Many rivers
   B. Six directions
   C. Two gods
   D. There is one God

11. What greeting shows respect with folded hands? (1 mark)
   A. Sat Sri Akal
   B. Shalom
   C. Hujambo
   D. Namaste

12. What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for? (1 mark)
   A. A big house
   B. Wisdom
   C. Rain
   D. Money

13. Which faith's story in the lesson is about honest earnings? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Hinduism

14. Amina pays Ksh 200 for sugar costing Ksh 150 and is given Ksh 100 change. How much extra did she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 150
   B. Ksh 200
   C. Ksh 100
   D. Ksh 50

15. What does it mean to pay your fare honestly? (1 mark)
   A. Pay the right amount and take your change
   B. Avoid paying
   C. Pay less
   D. Hide from the conductor

16. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Whisper answers
   B. Do your own work
   C. Copy from a neighbour
   D. Look in your bag

17. Which two of the Buddha's five precepts appear in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Not to run and not to sing
   B. Not to steal and not to lie
   C. Not to sleep and not to eat
   D. Not to swim and not to sit

18. To what does the Bhagavad Gita compare the soul in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A person who changes old clothes for new
   B. A river
   C. A stone
   D. A tree

19. Which Purushartha is about doing our duty and living rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Kama
   B. Moksha
   C. Dharma
   D. Artha

20. Which statement is true about kindness? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for humans
   B. It is only for adults
   C. It includes animals and nature
   D. It is only for rich people

21. Which of these is NOT true about the flag? (1 mark)
   A. It may touch the ground
   B. It should be respected
   C. It is a national symbol
   D. It is raised at ceremonies

22. In which year did Kenya gain internal self-government? (1 mark)
   A. 2010
   B. 1950
   C. 1963
   D. 1980

23. Which practice is part of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Shouting
   C. Fasting
   D. Hunting

24. Which is a good food safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. Eat with dirty hands
   B. Wash hands before eating
   C. Share used cups
   D. Leave food in the sun

25. Shani is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Saturn
   C. Venus
   D. Mars

26. What is the Indian name for Wednesday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Budhvaar
   C. Somvaar
   D. Guruvaar

27. Budh is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Saturn
   C. Mercury
   D. Jupiter

28. Mangal is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Mars
   C. Mercury
   D. Jupiter

29. Which is a use of the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the school timetable
   B. Fixing the dates of festivals
   C. Cooking rice
   D. Counting rainfall

30. Which planet is famous for its rings? (1 mark)
   A. Mercury
   B. Saturn
   C. Mars
   D. Venus

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

32. Explain how the school can plan a tree planting day that includes learners with special needs. (5 marks)

33. Describe an experiment to show that plants need water. (4 marks)

34. Describe how Sikhs show respect to Guru Granth Sahib Ji in a gurdwara. (3 marks)

35. Explain why forgiveness is important, using Paryushan Parva. (4 marks)

36. Explain the Jain teaching called Asteya. (2 marks)

37. Give three ways of showing respect to any scripture. (3 marks)

38. Why should children do Bhastrika and Kapaal Bhaati gently? (2 marks)

39. Explain what the white colour, the veena and the book stand for in the picture of Saraswati. (3 marks)

40. Explain how children who find it hard to speak can join in prayers at assembly. (4 marks)

41. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

42. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)

43. Match each element to its Sanskrit name: earth, fire, air. (3 marks)

44. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

45. Describe the early life of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Bodhi tree
   The Bodhi tree is a kind of fig tree, also called the peepal.

2. D — In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   The stand is called the Tulsi Vrindavan.

3. D — Early morning or evening
   Less water dries up in cooler hours.

4. C — Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna
   Tulsi leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna.

5. B — He stayed calm and kept his faith
   Prahlad kept his faith without fear.

6. C — A teacher who shows the path across the river of life
   Tirthankars guide people to freedom.

7. A — Listen to a resource person or visit a library
   We can listen, read and discuss.

8. A — Ram's sandals (paduka)
   Bharat ruled in Ram's name.

9. A — Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   Sharing with others is a Sikh teaching.

10. D — There is one God
   Ik Onkar means One God.

11. D — Namaste
   Namaste is done with folded hands.

12. B — Wisdom
   It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

13. B — Sikhism
   Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo.

14. D — Ksh 50
   Correct change is 50, so 100 minus 50 is 50 extra.

15. A — Pay the right amount and take your change
   Honesty includes paying fares.

16. B — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

17. B — Not to steal and not to lie
   Not stealing and not lying.

18. A — A person who changes old clothes for new
   The body is like worn clothes.

19. C — Dharma
   Dharma is right living.

20. C — It includes animals and nature
   Kindness includes all living beings.

21. A — It may touch the ground
   The flag should never touch the ground.

22. C — 1963
   On 1 June 1963.

23. C — Fasting
   Fasting, prayer and charity.

24. B — Wash hands before eating
   Hygiene is important.

25. B — Saturn
   Shani is Saturn.

26. B — Budhvaar
   Budh is Mercury.

27. C — Mercury
   Budh is Mercury.

28. B — Mars
   Mangal is Mars, the red planet.

29. B — Fixing the dates of festivals
   It lists festival dates.

30. B — Saturn
   Saturn has bright rings.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: Choose a suitable place and get permission, prepare seedlings, tools and water, and give each child a job they can do, such as holding seedlings, filling watering cans or drawing the plants. Care for the trees afterwards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for permission, preparing, jobs for all, inclusion of special needs, and continued care.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant bean seeds in two tins of soil. Water one tin every day and give none to the other. Compare them after one and two weeks. The watered seeds sprout and grow but the dry seeds do not.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two tins, 1 mark for different watering, 1 mark for comparing over time, 1 mark for the result.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is placed on a raised seat; people cover their heads, remove shoes and bow before it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Forgiveness removes anger, mends friendships and brings peace. On the last day Jains ask everyone for forgiveness with Micchami Dukkadam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Not taking what is not given, or not stealing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, keep it in a high place, wash hands before touching it, listen quietly, follow its teachings (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are active breathing exercises, so children need a teacher and must stop when tired.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: White stands for purity and peace, the veena stands for music and the arts, and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct meaning.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: They can hum, listen, join the actions or be helped by friends, so nobody is left out.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four sensible points.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Earth: Prithvi. Fire: Agni. Air: Vayu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: He was born in Lahore with the childhood name Jetha, lost his parents young, helped his family by selling boiled grain, and later served Guru Amar Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.
